project_context.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for High-Density Financial Terminal
project_context.primary_objective: Maximum data density and uncompromised legibility for quantitative analysis. No frills. Data is the hero.

data_tables.rules: CRITICAL: Monospace is mandatory for all numbers, prices, t-stats, and p-values to ensure decimal alignment. Use light to medium weights to reduce visual clutter in dense tables.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense). Every pixel must be utilized.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Condensed. Use p-2 to p-4 maximum for containers. Internal cell padding should be extremely tight (e.g., px-2 py-1).
layout_and_spacing.table_density: Row height 36-40px max. Condense wherever possible.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radii: 1px solid borders. NO rounded corners (rounded-none). Sharp edges only.
layout_and_spacing.persistent_elements: Safety banner 'LIVE DISARMED / READ-ONLY' MUST be permanently fixed to top (or bottom) with z-50.

components.tables: Ultra-dense. Right-align all numeric columns. Left-align text. Use 1px subtle borders between rows. Highlight hover row.
components.buttons: Utilitarian. Flat, 1px border. No shadows. Hover state just slightly lightens background.
components.cards: Cardless aesthetic or flat surfaces with 1px borders. Use border-collapse patterns where possible.
components.badges: Minimal padding (e.g., px-1.5 py-0.5), small monospace font for tags/status.

login.description: JWT Login Screen. Minimal centered box. Monospace branding.
login.layout_rules: Use the abstract dark grid image softly in the background with a heavy dark overlay.

data.description: Instrument list table, CSV upload utility, Synthetic generator controls, Yahoo fetch.
data.layout_rules: Toolbar at top, dense table taking up the remaining viewport height.

edge_lab.description: Session-scan, ny-conditional, overnight analysis with verdicts KEEP/EXCLUDE, t-stats.
edge_lab.layout_rules: Split views for parameters and results. Verdicts (KEEP/EXCLUDE) must use strict semantic colors.

significance_audit.description: The Hero View. Dense results table with family_size, mtc_survivors counters.
significance_audit.layout_rules: Massive, ultra-dense table. The 'mtc_robust' boolean column MUST be the most visually striking element (bright neon green text/badge).

bot_diagnostics.description: Rejection-taxonomy, market-structure, quality-review, demo-readiness report cards.
bot_diagnostics.layout_rules: Grid layout (Control Room style). Metric-heavy report cards.

ai_research.description: Multi-LLM chat/report panel with provider/model routing per task.
ai_research.layout_rules: 3-pane split: LLM selection/routing on left, chat/report stream in middle, context/metrics on right. Must enforce 'read-only' visual cues.

icons_and_assets.icon_library: lucide-react (using absolute minimum stroke-width, e.g., 1.5, to keep it technical)

image_urls.description: Intricate vertical wire mesh pattern. Use as a highly opaque background texture for the Login page (e.g., opacity-10).
Neon blue line chart on a grid. Can be used as an empty-state graphic in the Data page or AI Research pane.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text contrast must be heavily optimized for readability. The KEEP/EXCLUDE and mtc_robust colors must have enough luminosity to pop against the #0D1117 background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'IBM Plex Sans' (headings/UI) and 'IBM Plex Mono' (tables/numbers).
Build a strict Terminal/Bloomberg aesthetic. Dense, dark, sharp corners (rounded-none).
Implement the 'LIVE DISARMED / READ-ONLY' banner globally, ensuring it's always visible.
In Significance Audit, ensure the 'mtc_robust' column is overwhelmingly clear (e.g., a glowing green badge for 'true').
Do NOT use generic Shadcn soft shadows or large paddings. Override Shadcn defaults to be dense and flat.
